actions: OPEN INPUT FEED-IN I-O ACCOUNTS OUTPUT POSTINGS-OUT REJECT-OUT REPORT-OUT
CLOSE FEED-IN ACCOUNTS POSTINGS-OUT REJECT-OUT REPORT-OUT

rules.sentence: When `WS-ACCOUNTS-STATUS` is not `'00'`, it accepts `WS-RUN-DATE` from its command line; opens `FEED-IN` for input, `ACCOUNTS` to update, and `POSTINGS-OUT`, `REJECT-OUT`, and `REPORT-OUT` for output; and stops the run.

When `WS-ACCOUNTS-STATUS` is `'00'` and `WS-REJECTED` is more than zero, it accepts `WS-RUN-DATE` from its command line; opens `FEED-IN` for input, `ACCOUNTS` to update, and `POSTINGS-OUT`, `REJECT-OUT`, and `REPORT-OUT` for output; repeats its loop until `WS-AT-END` is `'Y'` (`FEED-AT-END`); performs `WRITE-REPORT`; closes `FEED-IN`, `ACCOUNTS`, `POSTINGS-OUT`, `REJECT-OUT`, and `REPORT-OUT`; and stops the run.

When `WS-ACCOUNTS-STATUS` is `'00'` and `WS-REJECTED` is at most zero, it accepts `WS-RUN-DATE` from its command line; opens `FEED-IN` for input, `ACCOUNTS` to update, and `POSTINGS-OUT`, `REJECT-OUT`, and `REPORT-OUT` for output; repeats its loop until `WS-AT-END` is `'Y'` (`FEED-AT-END`); performs `WRITE-REPORT`; closes `FEED-IN`, `ACCOUNTS`, `POSTINGS-OUT`, `REJECT-OUT`, and `REPORT-OUT`; and stops the run.
When reading `FEED-IN` finds no more records, it reads `FEED-IN` and sets `WS-AT-END` to `FEED-AT-END`.
When reading `FEED-IN` finds a record, it reads `FEED-IN` and performs `APPLY-RECORD`.
When `WS-REASON` is not spaces (not `RECORD-IS-GOOD`), it performs `VALIDATE-RECORD`, performs `REJECT-RECORD`, and leaves the section.

When `WS-REASON` is spaces (`RECORD-IS-GOOD`) and reading `ACCOUNTS` fails on its key, it performs `VALIDATE-RECORD`, sets `CA-CARD-NO` to `PF-CARD-NO`, reads `ACCOUNTS`, sets `WS-REASON` to `'CARD'`, performs `REJECT-RECORD`, and leaves the section.

When `WS-REASON` is spaces (`RECORD-IS-GOOD`), reading `ACCOUNTS` succeeds by its key, `PF-KIND` is `'P'` (`PF-PAYMENT`), and rewriting `CARD-ACCOUNT` fails on its key, it performs `VALIDATE-RECORD`, sets `CA-CARD-NO` to `PF-CARD-NO`, reads `ACCOUNTS`, performs `APPLY-PAYMENT`, rewrites `CARD-ACCOUNT`, and stops the run.

When `WS-REASON` is spaces (`RECORD-IS-GOOD`), reading `ACCOUNTS` succeeds by its key, `PF-KIND` is `'P'` (`PF-PAYMENT`), and rewriting `CARD-ACCOUNT` succeeds by its key, it performs `VALIDATE-RECORD`, sets `CA-CARD-NO` to `PF-CARD-NO`, reads `ACCOUNTS`, performs `APPLY-PAYMENT`, and rewrites `CARD-ACCOUNT`.

When `WS-REASON` is spaces (`RECORD-IS-GOOD`), reading `ACCOUNTS` succeeds by its key, `PF-KIND` is not `'P'` (not `PF-PAYMENT`), and rewriting `CARD-ACCOUNT` fails on its key, it performs `VALIDATE-RECORD`, sets `CA-CARD-NO` to `PF-CARD-NO`, reads `ACCOUNTS`, performs `APPLY-STATUS`, rewrites `CARD-ACCOUNT`, and stops the run.

When `WS-REASON` is spaces (`RECORD-IS-GOOD`), reading `ACCOUNTS` succeeds by its key, `PF-KIND` is not `'P'` (not `PF-PAYMENT`), and rewriting `CARD-ACCOUNT` succeeds by its key, it performs `VALIDATE-RECORD`, sets `CA-CARD-NO` to `PF-CARD-NO`, reads `ACCOUNTS`, performs `APPLY-STATUS`, and rewrites `CARD-ACCOUNT`.

conditions: PF-STATUS-CHANGE AND PF-STATUS NOT = 'A' AND PF-STATUS NOT = 'B' AND PF-STATUS NOT = 'C'

rules.sentence: When `PF-KIND` is not `'P'` (not `PF-PAYMENT`) and `PF-KIND` is not `'S'` (not `PF-STATUS-CHANGE`), it sets `WS-REASON` to `'KIND'`.
When `PF-KIND` is `'P'` (`PF-PAYMENT`) or `PF-KIND` is `'S'` (`PF-STATUS-CHANGE`); and `PF-KIND` is `'P'` (`PF-PAYMENT`) and `PF-AMOUNT` is at most zero, it sets `WS-REASON` to `'AMNT'`.

When `PF-KIND` is `'P'` (`PF-PAYMENT`) or `PF-KIND` is `'S'` (`PF-STATUS-CHANGE`); `PF-KIND` is not `'P'` (not `PF-PAYMENT`) or `PF-AMOUNT` is more than zero; and `PF-KIND` is `'S'` (`PF-STATUS-CHANGE`), `PF-STATUS` is not `'A'`, `PF-STATUS` is not `'B'`, and `PF-STATUS` is not `'C'`, it sets `WS-REASON` to `'STAT'`.

When `PF-KIND` is `'P'` (`PF-PAYMENT`) or `PF-KIND` is `'S'` (`PF-STATUS-CHANGE`); `PF-KIND` is not `'P'` (not `PF-PAYMENT`) or `PF-AMOUNT` is more than zero; and `PF-KIND` is not `'S'` (not `PF-STATUS-CHANGE`), `PF-STATUS` is `'A'`, `PF-STATUS` is `'B'`, or `PF-STATUS` is `'C'`, it sets `WS-REASON` to spaces.

conditions: CA-BALANCE NOT > ZERO OR PF-AMOUNT NOT < CA-STATEMENT-BALANCE

rules.sentence: When `CA-BALANCE` is at most zero or `PF-AMOUNT` is at least `CA-STATEMENT-BALANCE`, it subtracts `PF-AMOUNT` from `CA-BALANCE`, sets `CA-PAID-IN-FULL` to `CA-WAS-PAID-IN-FULL`, sets `PO-CARD-NO` to `CA-CARD-NO`, sets `PO-ACCOUNT-NO` to `CA-ACCOUNT-NO`, sets `PO-KIND` to `PO-PAYMENT`, computes `PO-AMOUNT` as `0 - PF-AMOUNT`, sets `PO-REFERENCE` to `PF-REFERENCE`, sets `PO-DATE` to `WS-RUN-DATE`, writes `POSTING`, adds 1 to `WS-PAYMENTS`, and adds `PF-AMOUNT` to `WS-PAID`.

When `CA-BALANCE` is more than zero and `PF-AMOUNT` is less than `CA-STATEMENT-BALANCE`, it subtracts `PF-AMOUNT` from `CA-BALANCE`, sets `PO-CARD-NO` to `CA-CARD-NO`, sets `PO-ACCOUNT-NO` to `CA-ACCOUNT-NO`, sets `PO-KIND` to `PO-PAYMENT`, computes `PO-AMOUNT` as `0 - PF-AMOUNT`, sets `PO-REFERENCE` to `PF-REFERENCE`, sets `PO-DATE` to `WS-RUN-DATE`, writes `POSTING`, adds 1 to `WS-PAYMENTS`, and adds `PF-AMOUNT` to `WS-PAID`.
